_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base-rate dominates: score drift and calm vol keep the path as a one-rung drift into Complacency unless a breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both anchor current phase Anxiety; only Analyst supplies explicit forward Complacency/HOLD, Narrative silent on next rung
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds ~47-58 and BTC remains low-conviction drift without vol expansion or ETF-flow shock
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks under 40 with rising VIX/negative funding (down) or spot ETF flows revive and F&G clears 62 (up)
